The preferred next asks for a stock/complex leaf that binds card/global rho via routing/adapters. This package discharges those two inventory classes for external leaf-reserve purposes from the complex cover's scalar/router sentences, narrowing global rho to peeled+high-part only.

Do not claim global rho=0, do not recompute A=0 or B_bits=2642, do not substitute 252 or 57604, do not open a CrocSwap PR, and do not claim a new kappa.
